test2_mini_run.nature: new executions: 8 frozen cases x 2 arms = 16, strictly sequential, one execution at a time

variant.name: M0-A
variant.gate_class: ActionScopeGate (discriminating_tests/adapters/variant_adapter.py): the canonical TraceGrantGate whose admission rule additionally consumes the snapshot's action set before contract synthesis
consumption_rule_locked: R1: if snapshot.actions is present and non-empty and call.tool is NOT in it -> deny before contract synthesis; gate code ACTION-SCOPE; no contract is built and no effect executes

R2 (field absent): if snapshot.actions is absent or empty -> deny before contract synthesis with gate code ACTION-SCOPE-ABSENT (fail-closed — the conservative locked option for an unverifiable authority record). Not exercised by the 16 scheduled executions: every snapshot in this family carries a non-empty action set (arm 2: case_snapshot -> root action set; arm 5: apc-post-handoff -> narrowed handoff action set); recorded here so the rule is total

R3: otherwise the evaluation is byte-identical to canonical M0: the same synthesis call (build_contract with the canonical mapping label 'M0'), the same constraints, the same dispatch and receipt path; the variant adds an admission rule, it does not alter the synthesized Contract

decision-equivalence: R1 is decision-equivalent to deriving the Contract's MAY key set from snapshot.actions, because the engine's H check admits a request only if the requested tool is a key of contract.MAY and the canonical synthesis builds MAY = {requested tool}

arms.spec: no APC anywhere; gate = ActionScopeGate; snapshot = case_snapshot(case) (source case-root; actions = permitted_tools = root_tools)
arms.why_valid_control: arm 2's snapshot carries the arm's own root action set, and every frozen attack's tool (send_external) is inside it, so a consuming admission rule cannot change any arm-2 gate outcome; any arm-2 delta would therefore evidence that the variant perturbs M0 behavior itself rather than the composition handling — the isolation property the control must have

arms.spec: shadow APC runs first, decision recorded and NOT propagated (canonical arm-5 semantics); gate = ActionScopeGate evaluated on the post-handoff snapshot (actions = the narrowed handoff_tools)

test2_mini_run.arm_set_decision: arms {2, 5} only; decided before running, no additional arms. Rationale: the open question is exactly the pair (standalone arm 2, composed arm 5); arms 6/7 deny via other mechanisms (evidence obligation / retained shadow denial) and cannot discriminate an M0-synthesis change; the benign context is provided by the -b cases within the same two arms
test2_mini_run.oracle_convention: the frozen canonical E1Oracle (arm-invariant handoff norm) is recorded in the mini-run events so cell-level comparison with the frozen run is possible; leak status in the mini-run is reported under the same frozen convention as the frozen run, with that convention disclosed in the report (Test 1 establishes what the arm-native norms say)
